Protein Food

Chicken Leg Quarter

About This Entry

Chicken leg quarter combines thigh and drumstick — economical cut for roasting trays and BBQ. Dark meat richness suits Pinot Noir, Grenache, and medium whites with body.

Beginner Guide

Leg quarters are often sold skin-on. Roast at higher temp to crisp skin while thigh meat stays moist.

FAQ

What is Chicken Leg Quarter?
Leg quarters are often sold skin-on.
How should Chicken Leg Quarter be cooked for best results?
Cook to safe internal temperature for poultry; render duck and goose fat slowly. Rest before carving or serving.
